entities.name: Noémia de Sousa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carolina Noémia Abranches de Sousa Soares, known as Noémia de Sousa, was a poet from Mozambique who wrote in the Portuguese language. She was also known as Vera Micaia. She was of mixed Portuguese and Bantu descent. De Sousa's poetry and involvement in Moçambicanidade was a large part of the anti-colonial literary movement of Mozambique.

entities.summary: Carolina Noémia Abranches de Sousa Soares, known as Noémia de Sousa, was a poet from Mozambique who wrote in the Portuguese language. She was also known as Vera Micaia. She was of mixed Portuguese and Bantu descent. De Sousa's poetry and involvement in Moçambicanidade was a large part of the anti-colonial literary movement of Mozambique.
